m.e: I know this because the minds of millions of humans exist within me.

m.t: Tus sueños y los míos están encerrados en nuestras mentes.
m.e: "Your dreams and mine are locked up in our minds."

m.t: Admiro los métodos que usa para tratar mentes vulnerables.
m.e: I admire the methods you use to treat vulnerable minds.

m.t: Has traicionado a las grandes mentes y a los valientes luchadores del pasado.
m.e: You have betrayed the great minds and brave fighters that have preceded you.

m.t: No dejes que las mentes pequeñas te afecten.
m.e: Don't let small minds get to you.

m.t: He visto las mejores mentes de mi generación destruidas por la locura.
m.e: I saw the best minds of my generation destroyed by madness.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #8106590 by Goatstein; English translation #8106587 by Goatstein

m.t: Las mujeres conocen sus propias mentes, Tim, y sus cuerpos.
m.e: Women know their own minds, Tim, and their bodies.

m.t: El ajedrez es una batalla entre dos mentes creativas.
m.e: Chess is a battle between two creative minds.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10308952 by carlosalberto; English translation #10308950 by carlosalberto

m.t: Después de todo, nosotros solo somos mentes.
m.e: We are just minds, after all.

m.t: Los proverbios nacen en las mentes de aquellos que han sufrido.
m.e: Proverbs are born in the brains of those who suffered.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10363228 by DJ_Saidez; English translation #7049887 by tiziri

m.t: Puedo blindar sus mentes contra tu poder.
m.e: I can shield their minds from your power.

m.t: Pero todo esto, son mentes.
m.e: But all this, these are minds.

m.t: Creo que tal vez están teniendo problemas manejando sus mentes alrededor de los, los números.
m.e: I think maybe they're having trouble wrapping their minds around the, uh, the numbers.

m.t: Quiero decir, en este punto tenemos una fusión de mentes con el personal del hospital.
m.e: I mean, at this point, we have a mind-meld with the hospital intake staff.

m.t: Grandes mentes discuten ideas; las mentes promedio discuten eventos; las mentes pequeñas hablan de la gente.
m.e: Great minds discuss ideas; average minds discuss events; small minds discuss people.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #11612235 by carlosalberto; English translation #11612210 by carlosalberto

m.t: La gente que vive sola siempre tiene algo en sus mentes que gustosamente compartirán.
m.e: People who live alone always have something on their minds that they would willingly share.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #6807898 by albrusgher; English translation #5859988 by Hybrid

m.t: Pondría muchas mentes a descansar.
m.e: It would put a lot of minds at rest.

m.t: Nuestras mentes transforman experiencias en símbolos.
m.e: Our minds transform experiences into symbols.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1289160 by marcelostockle; English translation #249534 by \N

m.t: Viajar enriquecerá inmensamente nuestras mentes.
m.e: Traveling will immensely enrich our minds.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1540088 by marcelostockle; English translation #325518 by AlanF_US

m.t: Un hombre, dos mentes.
m.e: One man, two minds.

m.t: Quería poder leer mentes.
m.e: I wanted to be able to read minds.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #9366279 by ignacio; English translation #9366285 by DJ_Saidez

m.t: Él puede leer mentes.
m.e: He can read thoughts.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1684101 by marcelostockle; English translation #1667919 by fanty

m.t: Yo puedo leer mentes.
m.e: I can read minds.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2518306 by marcelostockle; English translation #2301292 by CK

m.t: Nuestras mentes están abiertas.
m.e: Our minds are open.

m.t: La literatura no sirve para muchas buenas mentes. Con una ceguera lamentable dicen "no es real".
m.e: Many fine minds have no use for literature. In pitiful blindness, they say, "It's not real."
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2055596 by Shishir; English translation #2040156 by halfb1t
